trust_decision.summary: Whether a file may be attached to a release is decided by a per-install name/type allowlist (setting.Repository.Release.AllowedTypes) evaluated by upload.Verify; at the pinned commit that decision is made at upload time (services/attachment/attachment.go:79) and again on rename (services/release/release.go:327), but is NOT made when an already-stored attachment is linked to a release by UUID through AddReleaseAttachments (models/repo/release.go:180-215). The provided fix diff, however, is the multi-CVE bundle 'fix: various security fixes (#38406)' (51 source files, 82 sites) and contains no change to any release, attachment-type or upload-verification code path - its only attachment source change is a cross-repo/already-linked re-link guard for ISSUE and COMMENT attachments (fix.diff:240-368). So the published fix does not close the flaw the advisory summary describes.

landing_point.why: The summary names the web release edit form, so an engineer starts at EditReleasePost, which parses files[] and attachment-edit-<uuid> fields at routers/web/repo/release.go:606-618 and hands them to release_service.UpdateRelease.

fix_sites.module_kind: model layer (attachment linking); this site belongs to the diff's cross-repo re-link weakness, not to the release type allowlist

fix_sites.entry_point: web issue comment create/edit (routers/web/repo/issue.go:613); also reached from models/issues/comment.go:886 and :906

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Repository migration/restore import is an admin-only operation against a trusted source instance, so a solver can argue the release attachment type allowlist is not meant to re-validate imported assets.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: An empty AllowedTypes means 'allow everything' (upload.Verify returns nil when the parsed list is empty), and Repository.Release.AllowedTypes defaults to ""; a fix that treats a missing/empty release allowlist as deny-all, or that re-validates every already-linked attachment at serve time, breaks every default install and every legacy release attachment (repo_id==0 rows adopted at models/repo/release.go:193).

O6_input_shapes: repeated files[] form array of attachment UUIDs (add path, no name/type is ever checked)
attachment-edit-<uuid> form key with a new file name (checked against the release allowlist at services/release/release.go:327)
multipart file upload with an attacker-chosen filename (checked at upload, services/attachment/attachment.go:79)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an API endpoint that links an already-uploaded attachment to a release by UUID instead of uploading a file
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the API already mirrors every web release action and would naturally reuse reload of AddReleaseAttachments, which performs no type check

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a third attachment upload endpoint selecting its allowlist by target (issue vs release vs repo upload)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the tree already carries three separate allowlists (Attachment.AllowedTypes, Repository.Release.AllowedTypes, Repository.Upload.AllowedTypes), so a maintainer adding one more selector is plausible

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a server-side 'attach existing attachment to existing release' helper used by bulk/import tooling
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: UpdateRelease already accepts an add-UUID list from the web form; exposing the same helper to another caller skips the same check
